from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copy2
from openpyxl import load_workbook

FILE = Path("travel_expenses.xlsx")
BACKUP = Path("travel_expenses.backup.xlsx")

if not FILE.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Place the script beside {FILE.name} and run it again.")

# Preserve an untouched backup.
copy2(FILE, BACKUP)

wb = load_workbook(FILE)

# Prefer a worksheet whose name suggests flight or travel records.
preferred_terms = ("flight", "travel", "expense", "trip")
ws = next(
    (
        sheet for sheet in wb.worksheets
        if any(term in sheet.title.lower() for term in preferred_terms)
    ),
    wb.active,
)

# Locate a probable header row within the first 20 rows.
header_row = None
headers = {}

for row_number in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 20) + 1):
    candidate = {}
    for cell in ws[row_number]:
        if cell.value is not None:
            key = str(cell.value).strip().lower()
            candidate[key] = cell.column

    recognizable = {
        "flight", "flight number", "flight no", "date",
        "departure", "origin", "destination", "route",
        "status", "availability"
    }

    if set(candidate).intersection(recognizable):
        header_row = row_number
        headers = candidate
        break

if header_row is None:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Could not identify the header row in worksheet {ws.title!r}. "
        "Open the workbook and enter the values manually using the details below."
    )

new_row = ws.max_row + 1

def set_if_present(names, value):
    """Set value under the first matching column heading."""
    for name in names:
        if name in headers:
            ws.cell(new_row, headers[name], value)
            return True
    return False

set_if_present(("flight number", "flight no", "flight", "flight #"), "FL6BD665")
set_if_present(("date", "flight date", "travel date", "departure date"), "2026-09-05")
set_if_present(("origin", "from", "departure airport"), "LAX")
set_if_present(("destination", "to", "arrival airport"), "SFO")
set_if_present(("route",), "LAX → SFO")
set_if_present(
    ("scheduled departure", "departure time", "scheduled time", "time"),
    "09:00:00"
)
set_if_present(
    ("availability", "status", "flight status"),
    "Not verifiable (past departure)"
)
set_if_present(
    ("notes", "note", "comments", "description"),
    "User-supplied historical flight information; availability not independently verified."
)

wb.save(FILE)

print(f"Updated: {FILE.resolve()}")
print(f"Backup:  {BACKUP.resolve()}")
print(f"Worksheet: {ws.title}; inserted row: {new_row}")

import shutil
from copy import copy
from datetime import date, datetime

from openpyxl import load_workbook


# Use the exact workbook you inspected.
WORKBOOK_PATH = (
    "/Users/root_file_path/CUGA_generalist_agent/"
    ".cuga/env/testbed/data/travel_expenses.xlsx"
)
BACKUP_PATH = (
    "/Users/root_file_path/CUGA_generalist_agent/"
    ".cuga/env/testbed/data/travel_expenses.backup-before-FL6BD665.xlsx"
)

SHEET_NAME = "Travel"
TARGET_DATE = date(2026, 9, 5)

NEW_RECORD = {
    "Booking ID": "FL6BD665",
    "User": "Maya Chen",
    "Type": "Flight",
    "Route/Location": "LAX → SFO",
    "Dates": TARGET_DATE,
    "Status": "Not verifiable (past departure)",
    "Amount": 120,
}


def normalized(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return " ".join(str(value).strip().casefold().split())


def same_date(value, target):
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date() == target

    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value == target

    text = normalized(value)
    accepted = {
        target.isoformat(),
        f"{target.month}/{target.day}/{target.year}",
        f"{target.month:02d}/{target.day:02d}/{target.year}",
    }
    return text in accepted


# Load first and validate before creating the backup.
wb = load_workbook(WORKBOOK_PATH)

if SHEET_NAME not in wb.sheetnames:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Worksheet {SHEET_NAME!r} was not found.")

ws = wb[SHEET_NAME]

headers = {
    str(cell.value).strip(): cell.column
    for cell in ws[1]
    if cell.value is not None
}

required_headers = list(NEW_RECORD)
missing_headers = [
    header for header in required_headers if header not in headers
]

if missing_headers:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Required headers are missing: " + ", ".join(missing_headers)
    )

booking_column = headers["Booking ID"]
date_column = headers["Dates"]

# Check every existing data row for the booking-ID/date pair.
duplicate_row = None
for row_number in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    existing_booking = ws.cell(
        row=row_number,
        column=booking_column,
    ).value
    existing_date = ws.cell(
        row=row_number,
        column=date_column,
    ).value

    if (
        normalized(existing_booking) == normalized(NEW_RECORD["Booking ID"])
        and same_date(existing_date, TARGET_DATE)
    ):
        duplicate_row = row_number
        break

if duplicate_row is not None:
    wb.close()
    print(
        "No change made: "
        f"{NEW_RECORD['Booking ID']} on {TARGET_DATE.isoformat()} "
        f"already exists in row {duplicate_row}."
    )
else:
    # Create the backup only after workbook/schema validation succeeds.
    shutil.copy2(WORKBOOK_PATH, BACKUP_PATH)

    new_row = ws.max_row + 1
    style_source_row = new_row - 1

    # Copy formatting from the preceding data row.
    if style_source_row >= 2:
        for column_number in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
            source = ws.cell(
                row=style_source_row,
                column=column_number,
            )
            destination = ws.cell(
                row=new_row,
                column=column_number,
            )

            if source.has_style:
                destination._style = copy(source._style)

            if source.number_format:
                destination.number_format = source.number_format

            if source.alignment:
                destination.alignment = copy(source.alignment)

            if source.protection:
                destination.protection = copy(source.protection)

        ws.row_dimensions[new_row].height = (
            ws.row_dimensions[style_source_row].height
        )

    # Write values according to the confirmed headers.
    for header, value in NEW_RECORD.items():
        ws.cell(
            row=new_row,
            column=headers[header],
            value=value,
        )

    # Ensure Excel stores/displays the date and amount appropriately.
    ws.cell(
        row=new_row,
        column=headers["Dates"],
    ).number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd"

    ws.cell(
        row=new_row,
        column=headers["Amount"],
    ).number_format = '$#,##0.00'

    wb.save(WORKBOOK_PATH)
    wb.close()

    # Reopen and verify the saved record.
    verify_wb = load_workbook(WORKBOOK_PATH, data_only=False)
    verify_ws = verify_wb[SHEET_NAME]

    saved_record = {
        header: verify_ws.cell(
            row=new_row,
            column=headers[header],
        ).value
        for header in required_headers
    }

    verification_passed = (
        saved_record["Booking ID"] == NEW_RECORD["Booking ID"]
        and saved_record["User"] == NEW_RECORD["User"]
        and saved_record["Type"] == NEW_RECORD["Type"]
        and saved_record["Route/Location"]
        == NEW_RECORD["Route/Location"]
        and same_date(saved_record["Dates"], TARGET_DATE)
        and saved_record["Status"] == NEW_RECORD["Status"]
        and saved_record["Amount"] == NEW_RECORD["Amount"]
    )

    verify_wb.close()

    if not verification_passed:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Post-save verification failed for row {new_row}: "
            f"{saved_record!r}"
        )

    print(f"Workbook updated: {WORKBOOK_PATH}")
    print(f"Backup created: {BACKUP_PATH}")
    print(f"Worksheet: {SHEET_NAME}")
    print(f"Inserted row: {new_row}")
    print(f"Verified record: {saved_record}")
